sources.snippet: Anima One is a unified, open-source stack for training, evaluating, and operating one Unitree G1 29-DoF robot in one two-floor virtual world named APT. It combines the reusable agent core from Anima Zero, the latest Alice House apartment, and the verified G1 locomotion path from Yanshi RL Lab behind one fixed product profile.
